units.source_text: 以诚实著名的贤人夕雾大将，终于对这一条院的落叶公主起了恋情，

en.t: The wise General Yugiri, famous for his honesty, at last fell in love with Princess Ochiba of Ichijo-in,

units.source_text: 心中念念不忘。

en.t: and could not put her out of his mind.

units.source_text: 他在人前装作不忘故人旧情，

en.t: In public he pretended that he had not forgotten his old affection for the deceased,

units.source_text: 时时诚恳地前往慰问，

en.t: and from time to time went sincerely to offer consolation,

units.source_text: 但积年愈久，

en.t: but as the years passed,

units.source_text: 心底里愈觉不甘如此便罢。

en.t: deep down he felt increasingly unwilling to let matters end that way.

units.source_text: 老夫人觉得夕雾之诚恳十分难得，

en.t: The old lady found Yugiri's sincerity exceptionally rare,

units.source_text: 心甚感激。

en.t: and was deeply grateful.

units.source_text: 她近来生涯愈觉岑寂，

en.t: Her life had lately grown ever lonelier,

units.source_text: 夕雾常去访问，

en.t: and Yugiri visited often,

units.source_text: 给她安慰不少。

en.t: which gave her considerable comfort.

units.source_text: 夕雾当初并非为了求爱而来访的。

en.t: At first Yugiri had not visited in order to court her.

units.source_text: 他想：“此刻态度一变，忽然提出求爱，实甚唐突。

en.t: He thought, "If I change my manner now and suddenly propose love, it would be terribly abrupt.

units.source_text: 只有竭尽忠诚，将来公主未必不肯见容。”

en.t: If only I devote myself with complete sincerity, the princess may one day be willing to accept me."

units.source_text: 他想找个适当机会，探察公主心意如何。

en.t: He wanted to find a suitable chance to discover what the princess felt.

units.source_text: 但公主一直不曾亲自与夕雾会面。

en.t: But the princess had never met Yugiri in person.

units.source_text: 夕雾正在找寻机会，想把心事向她明言，

en.t: Yugiri was looking for an opportunity to speak plainly to her of what was in his heart,

units.source_text: 看她作何表示。

en.t: and see how she would respond.

units.source_text: 忽然老夫人为鬼怪作祟，生起病来，

en.t: Suddenly the old lady fell ill, troubled by evil spirits,

units.source_text: 移居比叡山麓小野地方的别墅里。

en.t: and moved to a villa in Ono at the foot of Mount Hiei.

units.source_text: 老夫人早年皈依一位律师，

en.t: In her younger days, the old lady had taken refuge with a certain risshi monk,

units.source_text: 此人善做祈祷，驱除鬼怪，

en.t: who was skilled at prayers and at driving away spirits,

units.source_text: 现在笼闭山中，誓不入市。

en.t: but now he lived secluded in the mountains and had vowed not to enter the city.

units.source_text: 惟小野近在山麓，可以请他下来。

en.t: Since Ono lay near the mountain foot, however, they could ask him to come down there.

units.source_text: 移居时所需车辆人夫，均由夕雾备办。

en.t: Yugiri arranged all the carriages and porters needed for the move.

units.source_text: 柏木的几个嫡亲兄弟，因为事务繁忙，生活烦乱，

en.t: Kashiwagi's own brothers were busy with affairs and distracted by disorderly lives,

units.source_text: 反而顾不到这位寡嫂家的事。

en.t: and so they could not look after matters in the household of their widowed sister-in-law.

units.source_text: 其中长弟左大弁红梅，对公主并非没有恋情，

en.t: Among them, the eldest younger brother, Kobai, the Left Major Controller, was not without feelings for the princess,

units.source_text: 曾经一度贸然求爱，惨遭公主坚决拒绝，

en.t: but he had once rashly courted her and been painfully and firmly rejected by her,

units.source_text: 此后便无颜再去访问。

en.t: and after that he had no face to visit again.

units.source_text: 只有夕雾非常贤明，若无其事地常来亲近公主。

en.t: Only Yugiri, being very wise, kept approaching the princess as if nothing were amiss.
